integrity.claim_scope: Exact finite moments, asymptotic variance and unique optimizer for all fixed retention parameters; joint Gaussian limit for interior retention.
integrity.computational_check: Finite weighted enumeration and exact rational moments in check.py; not an infinite proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Prüfer avoidance factorial moments and conditional multinomial occupancy Gaussian limit.

scientific_limitations: Code-position refreshing is not the same as graph-edge perturbation.
The joint Gaussian theorem is stated for fixed interior retention probability.
A general multistream occupancy theorem might subsume some calculations; historical priority is not independently established.
title: A unique intermediate-noise variance maximum for shared leaves of coupled Cayley trees
